messages:
Nora: Finally mounted my second monitor on the wall yesterday. feels VERY command-center. photo: https://imgur.com/example_monitor.jpg :star_struck:
Diego: nice! does it wobble when you plug in USB-C? my arm keeps shaking every time i reach for the mouse.
Nora: used a heavy-duty VESA arm, tightened the bolts twice. still wobbly if I lean on the desk though. thinking of adding a small shelf to rest the keyboard.
Samir: quick PSA  had a 10m outage at lunch, but thanks to my cheap UPS the desktop stayed alive and the meeting didn't drop. not a full home router UPS but enough to keep router + workstation up. highly recommend.
Ellie: which UPS did you get? we had a power flicker and my NAS rebooted mid-sync and i cried a little.
Samir: APC Back-UPS 650. cost effective. keeps my router + laptop dock alive for ~12 minutes during normal draw.
Diego: also consider ethernet-over-power adapters if your apartment wiring is decent. gives more stable latency than 5G hotspot for me. cheap ones improved my Zoom pings.
Ben: laptop webcam clamp rec rec: Neewer table mount with weighted base. cheap, holds a vlog cam too.
Nora: Ben's rec is solid. i added a small ring light behind it. background now looks like a tiny talk show. :microphone:
ISPBot: Scheduled network maintenance detected in your area at 2025-11-01T19:40:00Z. Expect intermittent connectivity.
Ellie: ack ISPBot. will schedule big deploys for later then. also curious  poll: would you rather have "perfect internet, meh chair" or "perfect chair, flaky internet"? react :thumbsup: for perfect internet, :heart: for perfect chair.
Samir: :thumbsup: internet all day. chair issues can be solved by lumbar pillows.
Nora: :heart: ergonomics matter. saved my back after 10 years of cheap chairs.
Diego: :thumbsup: my router is basically my baby. backups for everything else.
Ben: results mixed so far. conclusion: buy both if budgets allow.
Nora: thanks for the UPS tips everyone, ordering one tonight. will post a before/after battlestation photo when it arrives. cat already judged the monitor mount so that's a win. :cat2:
